rules.selection: Every unused-author human_only=True row, no response-driven selection.
rules.history: Source order, publisher Python codepoint index semantics, only User insert/delete/retain; strict bounds, finite nondecreasing timestamps; complete exact final span text. Never clamp, repair, reorder or invent characters.
rules.overlap: All680 prior full texts, normalized exact match and five-word shingle comparisons; shared>=20 and (Jaccard>=0.5 or smaller-set containment>=0.8). Corpus source words and row identities remain private.
rules.interpretation: Publisher-controlled human-only condition and edit-log consistency, not verified absence of all off-platform assistance. Same task pool; no topic-disjoint or pretrained-training-disjoint claim.
rules.unresolved: Keep every planned control in inventory. Invalid history or prior near-duplicate is explicit unsupported source, never a human verdict, omitted record or a detector false alarm.

data_terms: Institutional CC-BY-SA4 metadata and bundled GPL2 prose conflict retained; source wording, author identities, edit logs, queries and per-document annotations remain private. No new training/redistribution clearance inferred.
